title: Vibe Coding Unity
author: Appropriate-Cod7548
selftext: Hello! I see examples of AI generated games that are built on HTML. Is it possible to do that with Unity? Tried once with Claude. Doesnt seem to work. Some say you need to add MCP to the Unity IDE. How do you suggest I start developing Unity game with no prior Unity knowledge (I mostly do backend) and leveraging AI (Claude)?

comments.author: SushiMasterPro
comments.body:
I think MCP is really good start.  
But since you have backend experience you can start from other end buy game fro unity asset store or sell my app and try to understand how it works It cost like 50$ teach you some things well. Disclaimer often code there is messy.

I wish I would focus on backend. I think thats the future now so you will do great! Good luck

replies.author: Appropriate-Cod7548
replies.body: Well, backend on school projects though hehehe

replies.author: SushiMasterPro
replies.body: I think its good start. Just do first something small build your confidence! Good luck!

comments.author: Seven-Prime
comments.body:
Point your ai assistant at unity batch. Feed it the docs. Almost none of my unity work visually opens the editor.

If you come from a backend background, act as the project manager and architect for you agent. Flush out a game design document. Then have it implement the minimum slice of you game with simple block assets.

Also be wary of Vibe coding, you'll end up burning all your tokens. Investigate how to do spec driven design. Better yet, have your agent come up with a workflow for you based on your needs.

comments.author: Vindelator
comments.body:
"How do you suggest I start developing Unity game with no prior Unity knowledge?"

There's a million great, free official (and user-made) tutorials for unity. 

Totally run though those, and you'll get a lot of insight into the sort of things that are doable without  having to cook from scratch with AI.

"Some say you need to add MCP to the Unity IDE" I've had good experience asking [claude.ai](http://claude.ai) (or insert your AI of choice) to answer really specific tech questions about hooking things up. I learned a lot that I never would have otherwise.

comments.author: throwaway275275275
comments.body: You can do it with Godot because all the assets are text format, it still needs some MCP for the play/test/debug cycle but it can make the whole game

comments.author: lorendroll
comments.body: Don't use MCP, it is bulky and deprecated. Unity now released Unity CLI and Unity Pipeline. Install skill https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/skills and ask llm to use CLI with unity

comments.author: _Saturn1
comments.body: I've been doing this and its certainly been a struggle. Multiple bots keep suggesting outdated solutions despite being provided with the versions I am using. The difficulty is furthered by trying to optimize within Unity, havent had much luck pushing the needle on that front

comments.author: kimchi_pan
comments.body: See if you can create a strong testing framework, then start small, and see where it goes. I did build something is phaser and that went well, but not unity. But the core principles should be the same.
